Quiri ist top! Jack erinnerte sich nach 2 Jahren an meine Kids. Toller Hotpot & der Phở-Drink ist ein Muss. 5 Sterne! ⭐️⭐️
May 2026 • Couples
A Must-Visit in Cat Ba: Exceptional Service & Stunning Flavors
If you are looking for the heart and soul of Cat Ba’s dining scene, look no further than Quiri Bar & Restaurant. My recent visit was more than just a meal; it was a heartwarming reunion and a masterclass in hospitality.
The Legend of Jack
The standout feature of Quiri is undoubtedly Jack. Two years ago, Jack served my children with such genuine care and kindness that they still talk about him to this day. It was their glowing recommendation that brought me back—and Jack did not disappoint.
After sharing a few details about my kids, I was blown away when he remembered both of them. That level of personal connection is rare and made me feel like an old friend rather than just another tourist.
The Culinary Experience
We opted for the Seafood and Meat Hot Pot, and it was spectacular.
• The Quality: The ingredients were incredibly fresh, showcasing the best of the island’s local catch alongside high-quality meats.
• The Education: Jack provided an informative explanation of the hot pot process, ensuring we knew exactly how to prepare each ingredient to get the most flavor out of the broth.
• The "Phở" Drink: To top off the evening, Jack served his famous Phở-inspired cocktail. It was absolutely stunning—an inventive, aromatic, and delicious nod to Vietnam’s national dish that you simply have to try to believe.
Why You Should Go
Whether you are staying on Cat Ba for a few days or just passing through, Quiri Bar & Restaurant offers:
• Top-tier Service: Jack’s memory and attention to detail are unmatched.
• Delicious Food: Authentic flavors with fresh, local ingredients.
• Great Atmosphere: A perfect spot for families and solo travelers alike.
Bottom line: My kids were right—this place is a gem. Between the delicious hot pot and Jack’s world-class hospitality, Quiri made my stay on Cat Ba truly unforgettable.
Don't leave the island without stopping by!

terrible service experience
Apr 2026 • Solo
I chose this place because of its high rating (4.8) and many positive reviews, especially for the hot pot. Unfortunately, my experience was extremely disappointing.

It took around 40 minutes just to receive the stove. After 45 minutes, only noodles, mushrooms, and vegetables arrived. The meat came even later, and there was still no broth.

I had to remind the staff multiple times. When the broth finally arrived, it was cold. Even after 20 minutes on the stove, it only started to boil.

On top of that, the attitude of the staff made the experience worse. While I was already waiting for a long time, I was asked unnecessary and slightly condescending questions like “Have you had hot pot before?”, instead of receiving proper service.

At the end, I was also asked personal questions like whether my stomach felt okay, which felt inappropriate and unprofessional. A waiter’s role is to provide good service, not to question or judge the customer.

The service was incredibly slow and poorly organized. For a restaurant with such high ratings, this is unacceptable.

I cannot recommend this place based on my experience.
